ModMetaData.name: Actually Textbooks
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Textbooks in the classroom make lessons worth more.
Shelve textbooks in the room that holds your school desks and every student taught there learns faster:
- Each textbook raises lesson XP and lifts the daily XP budget for the skill it covers, so children stop hitting the 4000 XP/day saturation wall as early. - Quality is what matters. Awful textbooks are shelf filler; Legendary ones carry a whole classroom. - A textbook covers the subjects printed on it (1-2, chosen when the book was made). Collect a library that matches what your teacher actually teaches, or turn subject matching off in the settings to let any textbook boost any lesson. - Only the best few books per room count, with diminishing returns, so upgrading the shelf beats hoarding it.
No new items are added: the vanilla textbook is the textbook, so books from traders, quests and raids work right away. Books filed in a bookcase never deteriorate and always count; books dropped on the classroom floor count while unforbidden.
Vanilla reading is untouched: children can still read these same books for recreation and skill, up to the quality level cap the book itself carries, which is a second route into the same skills.
Requires Biotech for school desks and lessons. Everything is optional and configurable in the mod settings.
